title: A diagram limit from the two products and their equalizer
statement: Let $I$ be a small category and $M:I\to\mathcal C$ a diagram in a category $\mathcal C$, with smallness as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose the products [def-weil-category-product] $P=\prod_{i\in\mathrm{Ob}(I)}M(i)$ and $Q=\prod_{(\alpha:i\to j)\in\mathrm{Ar}(I)}M(j)$ exist. Let $s,t:P\to Q$ be characterized by $\operatorname{pr}_\alpha s=M(\alpha)\operatorname{pr}_i$ and $\operatorname{pr}_\alpha t=\operatorname{pr}_j$. Suppose $k:L\to P$ is an equalizer of $s,t$: $sk=tk$, and every $a:T\to P$ with $sa=ta$ factors uniquely through $k$. Then the cone with vertex $L$ and components $\operatorname{pr}_i k$ is a limit cone of $M$, meaning every compatible family $a_i:T\to M(i)$ factors uniquely through these components. Only these two products and this particular equalizer are required.
